bracketing_exemplars: Akron QB 2026 (34, this round - proven-MAC floor)
rationale_bullets: First MAC-round room with genuine returning FBS QB quality: Flores 82.5/39 (107 att, 527 @ 4.9, 8 TD as the designated runner) and Glasser 80.1/14 (439 yds starting the final 3 of '24 as a true FR; OFY '25; strong spring) both return.
The two-QB rotation is BY DESIGN per both prints (runner/passer split) - role clarity, not a battle; and the 2026 Power Spread is being installed specifically for the QB-run identity.
Cost: Labas (1,854 @ 71% - the actual 2025 passing production) expired; PS expects a step back in passing volume.
38, M: above every MAC-round QB so far on returning FBS tape; capped by small samples and the departed passer.

key_players.evidence: 80.1/14; 439 yds in 3 starts as '24 true FR; strong spring

bracketing_exemplars: Bowling Green RB 2026 (28, this round - one-man room, higher peak)
rationale_bullets: Real two-deep with FBS production on both rows: Townsend 73.9/82 (418 @ 5.1) returns and Liberty transfer Blue 65.3/47 (441 @ 5.4 + 162 rec L2Y) takes RB1.
Holy Cross transfer Clerveaux (1,704 @ 4.7 over 2Y) adds FCS volume; true FR Moore (PS #89, Athlon #1 recruit) was a spring riser; FB VanWetzinga (5 st) anchors the 21-personnel identity.
Losses absorbable: Biggins 76.1 expired and Cornist 76.0 -> UConn, but the room retains more proven RB depth than any MAC-round team except BGSU's one-man room.
28 = BGSU 28: depth-over-peak vs peak-over-peak - nets even; well clear of Akron 16.
Lewis 73.9/245 (3rd-Tm All-MAC, 596 @ 13.9, B2B 100-yd games) is the best returning WR grade of the MAC round - and sat in the portal feed as Withdrawn/no-dest; both prints start him, override STAYS.
Team RECV graded p80; behind Lewis it's spring buzz (Williams 69.3/29) and sub-50-target samples (Ruffin, Payne, Kruisenga).
TE import Allen (Fordham, 11 st, 327 @ 17.2) is a real FCS receiving TE (no cell); Robinson (JC 1,713) and Foster (ex-MSU) are projection.
Losses: Davis 74.4/150 -> Virginia, McIntosh 65.3/228 (eligibility appeal, treated gone), Temple -> Oregon State. 28 = Akron 28, above Buffalo 22 on the All-MAC anchor piece.

bracketing_exemplars: Buffalo OL 2026 (16, this round - next-best MAC-round OL)
rationale_bullets: ~46 career FBS starts return - by far the most of the MAC round: Koivisto 52.8/731 (13 st), Russell 61.2/508 (13 st, 'all-league candidate'), Nehf 51.3/352 (9 st), Booth 61.6/387 (23 gm - portal-return override, both prints' LT1), Ploucha 65.2/529, Iannuzzi 81.2/56 (1st-Tm Ivy '24; yr4 override).

Imports add lower-division starts: Georgetown's Maka (2nd-Tm Patriot Lg) + Swan, E. Illinois DiSanto (30 st), JC John Williams. HC is a Joe Moore Award OL coach; PS: 'may have the best OLine in the MAC.'
The counterweight is tape QUALITY: PBLK graded p1 (30.3, second-worst in FBS - partly 3-QB chaos but earned by largely this personnel); returning grades run 51-65 raw.
28: continuity + coaching pedigree over bottom-of-FBS pass-pro tape - just above the WKU-25 anchor and #1 OL of the MAC round.

key_players.name: Jacob Russell
key_players.evidence: 61.2/508; 13 st at LT; all-league candidate per Athlon

bracketing_exemplars: Bowling Green DL 2026 (34, this round - elite returning edge)
rationale_bullets: Loses the round's best DL tape: Heldman 93.2/568 (10.5 sk, #5 tackler) expired, plus Decker 60.7/484, Hayden 65.9/261 -> EKU, Bennett/Fisher/Conde/Kostus.

But ~1,200 rotation snaps return - more than Buffalo/Akron/Ball State combined: Demma 68.3/468 (13 st), Douglas 59.6/228 (TE->DE convert, 'break out in Year 2'), Bird 54.2/222, VanWetzinga 60.0/170 (spring injury - monitor), Denkins, Swanson.
Cornell feed-gap imports Reinbold (18 st, 74 tkl, 5 sk) and Van Fleet are real FCS starters; Zirkle/Cherry origins unprinted.
24: solid returning rotation without a high-end piece - between Buffalo's 14 (one starter) and BGSU's 34 (returning 85-grade edge).

key_players.name: JJ Douglas
key_players.evidence: 59.6/228 as true-FR TE->DE convert; breakout buzz

rationale_bullets: Everything left: Kwiatkowski 75.4/732 (#1 tklr, 2nd-Tm MAC, 3x POW) and Cochran 73.0/678 (#2 tklr) expired, plus L.Brown 61.6/409 and the rest - the top returnees combined for 42 tackles.
2026 room: White 60.1/181 (rotation), Earl 60.0/80 (bench), and TRUE FR Esper projected to start (Athlon) - zero proven pieces, no import production bought.
PS: 'looks weaker and is my biggest question'; Athlon: 'completely rebuilt.'
14, L: a hair above Buffalo's 12 on ~265 returning FBS snaps (vs their 2), far below BGSU's 30.
A COV-p81 unit loses five 350+ snap pieces: Carroll 74.6/722 -> TCU, Deasfernandes 73.1/631 -> Northwestern, Spann 74.5/519, Gordon 69.4/422, Rikard, Blackwell, plus Snell and Rowe.
Jackson 64.0/610 (3rd-year starter, 'unquestioned leader of the back line') is the one returning volume piece; Wyoming transfer Taylor 60.4/276 is the only other FBS tape.
Fills are FCS/journeyman/rookie: Bryant (UNC '24 -> N. Colorado 75 tkl), Philord (Campbell), feed-gap Ty Williams, true FRs J.Jones and Benaitis in the two-deep battle.
22 = Akron 22: PS expects the pass-defense rating 'to take a drop' - one anchor, everything else projection.

bracketing_exemplars: Buffalo ST 2026 (22, this round - system, no personnel)
rationale_bullets: P Declan Duley returns - 54 punts, 41.1 avg, 37.9 net, 18-I20, 13 st (PS P #14): the first proven returning specialist of the MAC round.
K job goes to rFr VanHuis (PS K #20, UA All-America HS pedigree, zero attempts) after Graham (14-17) expired; pedigreed rather than anonymous.
The unit's 2025 tape was bad (SPEC p7, PS STR #122; negative PR/KR per PS) and Ruffin's return jobs stay unproven.
26: the returning P #14 pulls this to the top of the MAC-round ST rooms despite the p7 team tape.
